Name: Wilderness Farm Redux
Author: cowboylikenyx
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8XgnouK.png[/img]

[b][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#6d9eeb]Wilderness Farm Redux[/color][/font][/b] is the third mod project that I've created for [url=http://stardewvalley.net/]Stardew Valley 1.5[/url]. This version of the wilderness farm will remove the big pond in the middle & the weird bump on the left side of the map (and an area on the bottom right of the map that I change to hardwood areas)

[b][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f4cccc][size=5]In order for this mod to work, you'll need:[/size][/color][/font]
[/b][list]
[*][b][url=http://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] by Pathoschild[/b]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] by Pathoschild[/b]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/url] by DaisyNiko[/b]
[/list][b]
[/b][b][b][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ea9999][size=5]Mods that I use in the screenshots:[/size][/color][/font]
[/b][/b][list]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url]﻿ by DaisyNiko[/b]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10038]Elle's Seasonal Buildings for AT[/url]﻿ by Junimods[/b]
[/list]
[b][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#dd7e6b][size=5]Installation:[/size][/color][/font]
[/b][list]
[*][b]Download the latest version of [url=http://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿ by Pathoschild[/b]
[*][b]Download the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ by Pathoschild[/b]
[*][b]Download the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/url]﻿﻿ by DaisyNiko[/b]
[/list][list]
[*][b]Unzip all the requirements file above and put it in Stardew Valley\Mods[/b]
[*][b]Download Wilderness Farm Redux and put it in ﻿Stardew Valley\Mods[/b]
[/list]
[b]I accidentally placed a bush without knowing, so here's a way to remove them:[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4715]Reset Terrain Features - PC[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304]Destroyabke Bushes - Android [/url](Download v.1.1.0)﻿
[/list][b]
[color=#cc4125]If you're facing any issues, you can contact me directly in Stardew Valley Official Discord or you can send me a Direct Message (duckie#0001)[/color][/b]
